ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does it mean to speak with expression? (1 mark)
   A. To speak in a whisper only
   B. To speak without pausing
   C. To speak very fast
   D. To use the voice to show meaning and feeling

2. To reply to a message means to (1 mark)
   A. answer it
   B. delete it
   C. ignore it
   D. forward it only

3. Which is a factual question about the passage? (1 mark)
   A. What kind of person is Kamau?
   B. Was the clean-up a success?
   C. Why do you think the head teacher smiled?
   D. What job did Class Six do?

4. What is an abbreviation? (1 mark)
   A. A long sentence
   B. A short way of writing a word or group of words
   C. A kind of question
   D. A type of story

5. What does the proverb 'Look before you leap' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Jump as high as you can
   B. Always look at your feet
   C. Think carefully before you act
   D. Do not go outside

6. An invitation is (1 mark)
   A. a big meal
   B. a song
   C. a gift
   D. a card or message that asks a person to come to an event

7. What is the contraction of 'I am'? (1 mark)
   A. Ia'm
   B. Im'
   C. I'am
   D. I'm

8. Choose the word that means 'to listen with your ears'. (1 mark)
   A. heer
   B. hair
   C. here
   D. hear

9. What is a riddle? (1 mark)
   A. A long story
   B. A kind of song
   C. A list of rules
   D. A word puzzle that describes something without naming it

10. What should you do if a website you find online worries you? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the adult
   B. Close it and tell a trusted adult
   C. Give your address
   D. Share it with everyone

11. Which word is the opposite of plump? (1 mark)
   A. healthy
   B. big
   C. thin
   D. round

12. The short form of 'I would' is (1 mark)
   A. I'll
   B. I've
   C. I'm
   D. I'd

13. How long should a Grade 4 pictorial composition be? (1 mark)
   A. 20 words
   B. 5 words
   C. 500 words
   D. about 60 to 80 words

14. Which word has a double r? (1 mark)
   A. library
   B. beautiful
   C. tomorrow
   D. necessary

15. What does the saying 'Unity is strength' mean? (1 mark)
   A. People are stronger when they work together
   B. Only leaders are strong
   C. Nobody needs friends
   D. The strongest person always wins

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write two reasons why people keep diaries. (2 marks)

17. Explain the difference between 'but' and 'so' with an example of each. (4 marks)

18. Create a short puzzle with four clues whose answers are irregular plurals. (4 marks)

19. Explain how intonation can change the meaning of 'Really?' (3 marks)

20. Give one riddle about an object used for cleaning, with its answer. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — To use the voice to show meaning and feeling
   Expression means changing loudness, stress and pitch to show feeling.

2. A — answer it
   To reply is to answer.

3. D — What job did Class Six do?
   The answer is stated in the text.

4. B — A short way of writing a word or group of words
   For example Dr. for Doctor.

5. C — Think carefully before you act
   It advises us to think before we do something.

6. D — a card or message that asks a person to come to an event
   An invitation invites someone to an event.

7. D — I'm
   The apostrophe replaces the a in am.

8. D — hear
   'Hear' is what we do with our ears.

9. D — A word puzzle that describes something without naming it
   The listener guesses the answer.

10. B — Close it and tell a trusted adult
   Staying safe means asking for help.

11. C — thin
   Plump means fat in a pleasant way and thin is its opposite.

12. D — I'd
   I would can be shortened to I'd.

13. D — about 60 to 80 words
   The design asks for about 60 to 80 words.

14. C — tomorrow
   'Tomorrow' is t-o-m-o-r-r-o-w.

15. A — People are stronger when they work together
   Working together makes a group stronger.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: To remember events; to practise writing; to record feelings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: 'But' shows a difference: It was late, but we stayed. 'So' shows a result: It was late, so we left.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 mark for each example.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: I have two of these and I walk on them: feet. You chew with these: teeth. Small animals that squeak: mice. Grown-up females: women.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each clue with a correct answer.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: A high rising voice shows surprise, while a low falling voice shows the speaker is not interested. So the tune of the voice shows feelings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way and 1 mark for linking to feelings.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: I have hairs but no head, and I clean your teeth. What am I? A toothbrush.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a clear riddle and 1 for the correct answer.
